question: Do I charge sales tax on the glass I sell, and can I buy my furnace and gas tax-free as a manufacturer?

nuggets.text: A dealer registers with the Tax Commissioner or the local commissioner of the revenue for each place of business before doing business.
nuggets.quote: Every person desiring to engage in or conduct business as a dealer in this Commonwealth shall file with the Tax Commissioner or the local commissioner of the revenue, if the local commissioner elects to provide the services authorized under this section, an application for a certificate of registration for each place of business in this Commonwealth.

nuggets.text: A tax is levied on every person selling tangible personal property at retail.
nuggets.quote: There is hereby levied and imposed, in addition to all other taxes and fees of every kind now imposed by law, a license or privilege tax upon every person who engages in the business of selling at retail or distributing tangible personal property in this Commonwealth

nuggets.text: A return is filed for each period even when no tax is due.
nuggets.quote: A sales or use tax return shall be filed by each registered dealer even though the dealer is not liable to remit to the Tax Commissioner any tax for the period covered by the return.

nuggets.text: The tax is delinquent on the twenty-first day of the following month.
nuggets.quote: The tax imposed by this chapter shall for each period become delinquent on the twenty-first day of the succeeding month if not paid.

nuggets.text: Machinery, tools, fuel, power and supplies used directly in manufacturing products for sale are exempt.
nuggets.quote: (iii) machinery or tools or repair parts therefor or replacements thereof, fuel, power, energy, or supplies, used directly in processing, manufacturing, refining, mining or converting products for sale or resale;

nuggets.text: Whether a business is industrial in nature is decided without regard to its size.
nuggets.quote: is industrial in nature shall be made without regard to plant size, existence or size of finished product inventory, degree of mechanization, amount of capital investment, number of employees or other factors relating principally to the size of the business.

nuggets.text: The exemption is claimed with a certificate given to the supplier; otherwise the sale is taxable.
nuggets.quote: All sales or leases are subject to the tax until the contrary is established. The burden of proving that a sale, distribution, lease, or storage of tangible personal property is not taxable is upon the dealer unless he takes from the taxpayer a certificate to the effect that the property is exempt under this chapter.
